note: Assignment of every tests/Feature top-level group to a CI lane, an exclusion, or a deferral. Enforced by tools/feature-lane-manifest-check.php, which runs as a discrete step in the backend-architecture job (no `if:` guard, in all-checks-pass `needs`). A new directory has no entry here and FAILS the check - that is the whole point: before this file, a new Feature class in an unlisted directory ran nowhere, forever, and nothing said so. `classes` is an ENFORCED non-growth CEILING for `deferred`/`excluded` groups AND for groups laned into a lane that is still PARKED behind an execution gate: such a group may shrink freely and may NEVER grow, so a new class there fails CI until the ceiling is raised deliberately or the lane actually executes. It is NOT documentation. O-29 (2026-08-21): the 71 formerly `deferred` groups now carry real lanes, 8 self-hosted jobs partitioned by module family; those jobs are guarded by `vars.SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_READY` and execute on no event until the owner registers the runner and flips it. Full design: docs/handoff/DESIGN-f2-feature-lane-execution-2026-08-21.md.

dispositions.lane: Runs automatically in the named CI lane. New classes in the group are picked up with no edit here — UNLESS the lane declares an `execution_gate`, in which case the lane is wired but parked, the group keeps its enforced ceiling, and the parked total is reported loudly on every run until the gate is flipped.
dispositions.excluded: Genuinely cannot run in CI (needs a device, an external service, a manual fixture). Requires `reason`.
dispositions.deferred: CAN run, but no lane runs it yet. Requires `reason`. Counted loudly on every CI run. After O-29 exactly one group is left here — `(root files)`, which no whole-directory selector can address.

security-regression.events_note: EVERY event that starts the workflow — PR->dev, PR->main, push->main, workflow_dispatch. The job has NO `if:` guard, by the parent ruling of 2026-08-19 on brief F-2's sub-decision. It was previously a step inside the `if:`-gated backend-test job and therefore did not run on PR->dev.
security-regression.note: Whole directory, not a filter list, so new classes are gated the moment they land.
